cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before congratulating the winner, apologise for starting me behind the shed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Yes. I spent the first ten seconds finding the race.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely opening. Add 'and that was unfair to you.'
